name: Tingman Cube 3x3
description: The Tingman Cube is a WeiLong V10 that is already lubed, tensioned, compressed, and ready to go! This 20-magnet ball core 3x3 was tediously tested by Tingman himself over weeks to get the set-up just right. This is the cube he settled on, and he gave us specific instructions on how to set it up. If you want the top-of-the-line Tingman puzzle, look no further.
